hook: This island changes country every six months.
twist: Pheasant Island, a 200-metre river island between Irun (Spain) and Hendaye (France), is the world's smallest condominium: Spain runs it from 1 February to 31 July, France from 1 August to 31 January. France even has an official titled 'viceroy of Pheasant Island'. And there are no pheasants on it.
angle: How does a country share an island by taking turns, and why? The 1659 peace conference on the island, the royal meetings, then the six-month swap; paper calendar flipping between two flags on a real map of the Bidasoa.
why_now: Evergreen (no dated hook; timeliness scored 1). On publish day (21 Oct) the island is French until 31 January.
risks: When the six-month alternation began is disputed: Wikipedia ties the condominium to the 1659 Treaty of the Pyrenees, CNN dates condominium status to 1866, and Wikipedia's note (Mermoz) dates the alternation to an 1856 treaty and a 1901 agreement. Do not date the swap; say only that the 1659 peace was made there and that it is shared today.
